em:setting_dye_seal_hour_factor_comment: Sealing time for plant based dyes in hours. Default is 62.
em:setting_saltpeter_curing_comment: Can diluted saltpeter be used to preserve food?
em:setting_ore_panning_comment: Should some rare or unobtainable ores like uranium be added to the panning list?
em:setting_flint_factor_comment: How much crushed flint you get for one piece of flint in the pulverizer
em:setting_flint_crushing: Crush flint spear and arrow heads
em:setting_flint_crushing_comment: If enabled, flint spears and arrow heads can be crushed in a pulverizer
em:itemdesc-powdered-metal-temporal:
Vibrates faintly.

Better hold your breath while handling it.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-metal-: Might be useful to create objects that glow blue or purple.
game:handbook-item-usage-crushed-metal-t: Grind into a fine powder to use it.
em:itemdesc-ash-organic-plant-dry: A mix of various plants burned down to ashes.
em:itemdesc-ash-organic-wood-dry: A mix of various wood types burned down to ashes.
em:itemdesc-ash-organic-tang-dry: A mix of various tang, algae and seeweeds burned to ashes.
game:handbook-item-usage-ash-organic-pla: Dry with medium heat to turn into soda.
game:handbook-item-usage-ash-organic-woo: Dry with medium heat to turn into potash.
em:itemdesc-ash-organic-tang-sludge: Concentrated wet organic tang and kelp ash.
em:itemdesc-ash-inorganic-rock: Very finy fragments of rock, crystals and mineral glass.
game:handbook-item-usage-ash-inorganic-r: Can be used as a fertilizer.
game:itemdesc-ore-corundum: Used as an abrasive to smooth and polish things.
game:itemdesc-ore-kernite: In powdered form it can be used to create borax.
game:handbook-item-usage-crushed-metal-u: Grind into a fine powder to use it.
game:handbook-item-usage-crushed-ore-pho: Grind into a fine powder to strenghten the glow of other ingredients.
game:handbook-item-usage-crushed-ore-cor: Hard edges make corundum ideal for planing even the hardest surfaces.
game:handbook-item-usage-crushed-ore-cup: Mixing copper with nickel creates a more resistant alloy.
game:handbook-item-usage-crushed-chromit: An important ingredient for heat-resistant refractory bricks. Grind into a fine powder to use it as pigment.
game:item-handbooktext-ore-corundum: Hard semi-transparent crystals in many different colors. Rubies and sapphires are two common variants.
game:itemdesc-acid-full-nitric: Very strong acid, do not ingest!
game:itemdesc-acid-full-hydrochloric: Very strong acid, do not ingest!
game:item-handbooktext-acid-full-hydroch: Hydrochloric acid is produced by cooking (in a cooking pot) one portion of saltpeter, one portion of powdered alum, one portion of salt and one portion of copper or iron sulfate.
game:itemdesc-sulfate-full-copper: A solution of blue vitriol in water.
game:itemdesc-sulfate-full-iron: A solution of green vitriol in water.
game:itemdesc-sulfate-full-zinc: A solution of white vitriol in water.
game:itemdesc-sulfate-full-calcium: Calcium sulfate suspended in water, also known as aqueous gypsum.
em:itemdesc-crushed-metal-rusty: Ancient black metal edges glint through the rust.
em:itemdesc-crushed-ore-cupronickel: Crushed pieces of a copper-nickel metal alloy.
em:itemdesc-crushed-ore-magnetite: Light shimmers and gleams on the crystals.
em:itemdesc-powdered-metal-nickel: Despite the ore's silverish shine, nickel results in deep blue or even black colors.
em:itemdesc-powdered-metal-tin: Heat it in a fire to obtain tin oxide.
em:itemdesc-powdered-metal-uranium:
Emits a faint yellow glow.

Do not inhale!
em:itemdesc-powdered-metal-zinc: I wonder what this could be used for?
game:itemdesc-powder-alum: Can be used as a mordant for dye making.
game:itemdesc-powder-cinnabar: Cinnabar, ground into a bright red-orange powder.
game:itemdesc-powder-lapislazuli: Lapis lazuli, ground into a fine deep blue powder.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-boneash: An important ingredient for porcelain, milky glazings and glass.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-cassiterite: White pigment and clouding agent, useful as mordant for dye making.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-chromite: Can be used as a mordant for dye making.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-corundum:
Very fine abrasive powder.

Do not inhale!
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-cupronickel: A blend of copper, nickel and traces of iron.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-cuprorivaite: ... the Pharaoh ascertained his temple be refulgent blue like the skye.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-electrum: A blend of gold and silver.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-ilmenite: Makes glass colors appear stronger and brighter.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-kernite: Can be used to create borax.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-limonite: Also known as yellow or gold ochre.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-magnesiumoxide: Magnesium oxide (MgO), also known as burned magnesia.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-magnetite: Light still glimmers and glints on this otherwise deep black powder.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-pentlandite: Roast it to remove sulphides and obtain nickel.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-phosphorite:
Emits a very faint white glow.

Do not inhale!
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-prussianblue: The kings guards wore their blue coats with pride, until death.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-redphosphorus:
Emits a faint red glow.

Do not inhale!
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-rhodochrosite: Gives glass and ceramic glazes a pink, violet or dark green color.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-soda: Sodium carbonate, also known as soda ash.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-whitephosphorus: Glows in the dark. Do not inhale!
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-whitelead:
White pigment.

... and they placed lead pieces in pots with strong vinegar, covered them in manure and spent tannin and left them for three fortnights...
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-yellowcake:
Concentrated uranium oxide.

Don't eat the yellow cake.
em:itemdesc-powdered-ore-zincoxide: Also known as zinc white. An ingredient for bright white paint and glazings.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered: Used as pigment to stain and colorize various products.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-metal-: Produces blue or green colors if combined with lime. Copper alone produces a very dark red, opaque glass.
Roasting lead will result in lead oxide which is a basis for bright yellow and red pigments.
Useful for creating deep blue, black or purple colors.
Creates green, brown, gray or even black colors.
Heating tin will turn it into tin oxide, a white powder used in glazings.
Might be useful to create objects that glow yellow or green.
Might be useful to coat other metals to increase their corrosion resistance.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-stone-: Contains aluminium oxide and traces of iron oxides. These create orange or red colors.
Powdered granite is an important ingredient for porcelain.
Can be useful for dark glass colors.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-bo:
An important ingredient for the finest porcelain, milky glazings and milky glass. Can also be used as a fertilizer.
Heat with coke to reduce it to white phosphorus.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-ca: Creates white colors and turns mixtures opaque.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-ch: When heated, turns into chromium oxide, which has a vibrant green color.
Powdered chromium oxide, also known as Viridian. Creates a rich and deep green color in dyes, glazings and glass.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-co: Useful as black pigment and for making bombs.
Used as blue pigment for colored glass, glazes, dye and paint.
Used as green pigment for colored glass, glazes, dye and lightfast paint.
Used as red pigment for colored glass, glazes, dye and paint.
Copper (II) oxide, also known as black copper.
Composed of thousands tiny sharp crystals, corundum is ideal for polishing even the hardest surfaces.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-cu: A blend of copper and nickel, often strengthened by adding traces of iron and manganese.
A light blue powder, used in dye making and as pigment.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-fl: Can replace borax in glass making and glazes. Increases the glow of luminous materials.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-el: What could it be useful for?
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-ga: Roasting galena will remove the sulphides and result in powdered lead oxide which is a basis for bright yellow and red pigments.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-gr: Powdered graphite is used in ceramics and for electronic components.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-gy: Can be turned into plaster by mixing it with a bit of water.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-he: Powdered iron oxide, creates orange or red colors.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-il: Raw titanium can be added to glass batches to create deeper colors.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-in: Creates a strong blue dye, which can dye cloth without needing an mordant.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-io:
An antisepticum.
-> Install the mod Vintage Healing to make use of it.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-ke: Seal in a barrel with water to turn it into borax.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-la: Lapis lazuli ground to a fine powder. Creates deep blue colors.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-le: A mix of red and yellow lead oxides. Carefully heating and cooling it will turn this into bright yellow and red pigments.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-li: Powdered iron oxide, creates yellow or orange colors.

A form of lead oxide with a bright red color.
Used as pigment to stain and colorize various products.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-ma: Produces white colors and can be used in heat-resistant products.
Slightly magnetic mixture of powdered iron oxides, used for black colors and to darken glass.
Powdered malachite, a bright green-blue copper oxide mixture, also known as copper carbonate. Creates a wonderful teal color.
Produces black or dark brown colors and discolors glass by removing iron oxid impurities.
Produces rich and deep green colors.
Produces rich and deep purple colors.

A brightly yellow colored form of lead oxide.
Used as pigment to stain and colorize various products.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-pe: Roasting pentlandite will remove impurities and result in nickel which can then be used to color or stain various products.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-pi: An explosive powder, handle with care. Can produce blasting powder, yellow dye or be used as an antiseptic.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-ph: Increases the glow of objects in the dark.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-pr: A deep blue pigment, creating rich, lightfast colors and glazes.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-qu: Powdered quartz appears almost white and is the base for all glass and glazing recipes.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-rh: Also known as Manganese carbonate. Used alone it will create pink or violet shades, together with iron it produces a lovely dark green color.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-re: Might be useful to create objects that glow reddish or orange.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-sp: Zinc sulfide. Roasting it will remove the sulphur and create powdered zinc.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-so: Soda crystals are used to produce washing soda or lye.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-ti: A bright white pigment, used for coloring glass and glazings.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-wh: Might be useful to create objects that glow bright.
Used as pigment in glazings and white glass.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-ye: A strong pigment that causes glass to glow yellow or green in the dark.
game:handbook-item-usage-powdered-ore-zi: Used as white pigment in dyes, glazings and glass.
em:itemdesc-causticpotashportion: Caustic potash solution, a very strong base. Neutralizes acids and reduces most materials. Handle with care.
game:itemdesc-slakedlimeportion: A weak base. Used to make mortar.
em:itemdesc-washingsodaportion: A weak base, useful for cleaning and making soap.
em:itemdesc-causticsodaportion: Sodium hydroxide, also known as caustic soda, a very strong base. Handle with care.
